name: Old Ivory Hunt (Lão Nha Liệp)

bonuses.effect: Drag It to the Ice (Duệ Thượng Băng)
bonuses.rule: while the foe is Bound (it cannot flee), each second Bound holds you heal 1 % of your health and the foe takes 4 % more Physical damage from you; the bonus lasts while Bound holds and ends when Bound ends.

story: The founder's harpoon, the coat cut from the strip of hide the Old Ivory left on it, and his sworn brother's ring. Đoàn wears all three on every hunt; he says he will take them off when the whale is dead.
